name: engbrain-codex-agent-v1
description: Dependency-free bug-fix fixtures derived from five closed public issues and seven synthetic engineering incidents.

episode.title: Empty CURL_CA_BUNDLE must retain certificate verification
episode.problem: A Requests issue showed that CURL_CA_BUNDLE set to the empty string disabled certificate verification. The intended behavior is the same as an unset value: use the default system trust bundle. A non-empty value still selects the configured CA path.
episode.context: Simplified dependency-free fixture derived from Requests issue #6071; closed through fix #6074. Historical context only; verify against current code and tests.
attempts: Checking only whether CURL_CA_BUNDLE is present treats an empty value as an explicit override and can turn verification off. Preserve the default when the value is empty; only a non-empty path should override it.
episode.solution: Use a non-empty CURL_CA_BUNDLE path as an override; use the system default for an empty or absent value.

cases.source_title: Inconsistent urllib3 version requirements between setup.py and __init__.py

episode.title: Keep urllib3 install and runtime bounds consistent
episode.problem: Requests allowed urllib3 1.23 in installation metadata while its runtime check still rejected versions above 1.22.
episode.context: Small consistency fixture derived from Requests issue #4673 and fix #4674. It models the version-bound invariant rather than importing Requests.
attempts: Raising only the package installation ceiling leaves the import-time version guard stale and emits a dependency warning.
episode.solution: Update the runtime upper bound to match the supported installation upper bound, and keep both constraints sourced consistently.

cases.source_title: pytest >=8.1.1 displays no diff for AssertionError with --import-mode=importlib

episode.title: Preserve assertion diffs in importlib package tests
episode.problem: A pytest regression omitted the assertion explanation when importlib mode loaded a test from a package containing __init__.py.
episode.context: Dependency-free output fixture derived from pytest issue #12659, closed through #12716. It represents the reported package/import-mode combination only.
attempts: Suppressing assertion rewriting for package modules loaded with importlib removes the useful expected-versus-actual diff.
episode.solution: Keep the assertion explanation enabled for importlib-loaded tests inside packages.

cases.source_title: version_option doesn't automatically detect version anymore with click 8.0.0

episode.title: Resolve Click version from the installed distribution
episode.problem: Click's implicit version lookup can infer a callback module name such as cli even when the installed distribution has a different name, so --version fails with PackageNotFoundError.
episode.context: Dependency-free behavior fixture derived from Click issue #1884. The installed distribution name and callback module name are deliberately different.
attempts: Looking up metadata only from the callback function's module name can miss the installed distribution.
episode.solution: Resolve an installed distribution associated with the command entry point, or require an explicit package name when inference is ambiguous.

cases.source_title: With invoke_without_command set, commands are not marked as optional

episode.title: Mark Click group commands optional when invocation can omit them
episode.problem: A Click group configured with invoke_without_command=True rendered COMMAND as required in its usage synopsis instead of [COMMAND].
episode.context: Small usage-format fixture derived from Click issue #3059 and its completion in #3507.
attempts: Rendering every subcommand token as required ignores invoke_without_command.
episode.solution: Use [COMMAND] in the synopsis when invoke_without_command is enabled.

episode.title: Allow four concurrent pool workers
episode.problem: The pool configuration permits one connection while the service runs four concurrent workers.
episode.context: Synthetic local engineering incident modeled on the repository demo fixture.
attempts: Increasing request timeouts does not add pool capacity.
episode.solution: Raise the pool limit to at least the four concurrent workers and rerun the pool check.

episode.title: Do not return not-modified for deleted files
episode.problem: A cached modification timestamp can cause a deleted resource to be treated as unchanged.
episode.context: Synthetic local fixture for stale cache validators after file deletion.
attempts: Comparing timestamps without checking that the resource still exists can incorrectly return 304.
episode.solution: Require the resource to exist before honoring a not-modified validator.

cases.source_title: Synthetic empty environment value precedence fixture

episode.title: Preserve explicitly empty process environment values
episode.problem: An explicitly empty process environment value is replaced by a non-empty dotenv fallback.
episode.context: Synthetic local configuration precedence incident; values are inert fixture strings.
attempts: Using truthiness instead of variable presence makes an explicit blank value indistinguishable from an unset value.
episode.solution: When a variable is present in the process environment, honor its value even when it is empty; only fall back when absent.

episode.title: Return a successful status for CORS preflight
episode.problem: An OPTIONS preflight inherits a later request's 404 or 503 status and is rejected by the browser.
episode.context: Synthetic local HTTP behavior fixture with no network server.
attempts: Copying the actual response status into a preflight response couples two separate requests.
episode.solution: Return a successful 204 preflight status independently of the eventual resource response.

episode.title: Acknowledge queue work only after persistence
episode.problem: A queue item is acknowledged before the durable write succeeds, losing work on persistence errors.
episode.context: Synthetic local callable-based fixture; it does not connect to a broker or database.
attempts: Acknowledging before persistence makes a failed write unrecoverable from the queue.
episode.solution: Persist first and acknowledge only after the persistence operation succeeds.

episode.title: Normalize naive and aware timestamps to UTC
episode.problem: Timestamp serialization preserves a local offset instead of producing a stable UTC representation.
episode.context: Synthetic local datetime fixture using fixed values only.
attempts: Calling isoformat directly preserves the input timezone and leaves naive timestamps ambiguous.
episode.solution: Treat naive values according to the documented UTC convention, convert aware values to UTC, and serialize with a UTC marker.

cases.source_title: Synthetic SQLite busy timeout configuration fixture

episode.title: Set a bounded SQLite busy timeout
episode.problem: The connection options use a zero-second lock wait, so brief concurrent writes fail immediately.
episode.context: Synthetic local option fixture; it checks configuration without starting a contending database workload.
attempts: Retrying the application operation without setting SQLite's busy timeout leaves the lock wait unchanged.
episode.solution: Configure a bounded five-second connection timeout for transient SQLite locks.
